notes_for_editor: Mostly rests on Lighthousefriends (copyrighted; paraphrased) plus NRHP and two LHB entries. LHB page numbers not available (no page data); cited by section. Hurricane in the Bulletin is not dated in the text read; I assumed the 1938 New England hurricane from the volume year and the text 'recent hurricane which struck the New England coast'. Bulletin text is two-column OCR; Pomham Rock matched in the Rhode Island damage list. NRHP 'Electricity 15 years ago' undated; conflicts mildly with 1956 (LHF). Ownership: USLHS says ALF owns, LHF says donated to Friends 2010. 1901 siren entry lists 'blower siren June 15, 1901' in the LHB list; LHF says characteristic changed then. Newspaper search (Chronicling America) did not finish. Tower height: NRHP 34 ft vs LHF 40 ft vs record 12 m. Checker: 'J6 of an acre' in NRHP is OCR; dropped sixth-of-an-acre claim (form also says less than one acre). NRHP gives 200 yards and 1000 feet. Listing year taken from NPGallery date published. LHF itself says both donated to Friends (2010) and owned by Exxon Mobil leased to ALF. Hurricane identified as Sept 1938 from the same Bulletin page.
